# META 2012 - Valentin Turchin Workshop on Metacomputation

> Official website for the META 2012 workshop on metacomputation, partial evaluation, and program transformation held in Pereslavl-Zalessky, Russia.

META 2012 is an international academic workshop honoring Valentin Turchin's work in metacomputation and supercompilation. The event brings together researchers from institutions like the Ailamazyan Program Systems Institute, University of Copenhagen, and the Russian Academy of Sciences.

## Key Topics

- metacomputation
- partial-evaluation
- supercompilation
- program-transformation
